claim_text: EasyEquities says a security incident affected some of its systems
summary: EasyEquities says it became aware of a security incident affecting some of its systems and is investigating it with independent specialists. It emailed every client about it on Nov 26.
detail: The company has not said when it found the incident, which systems were affected or how it happened.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: Help page: "We've become aware of a security incident affecting some of our systems, and we're investigating it with independent specialists"; TechCentral quotes the same words from the client email.

claim_text: EasyEquities has restricted client logins and is keeping its platform offline
summary: As a precaution, EasyEquities restricted client login and some services on Nov 26 and is keeping the platform offline while it completes checks. Clients cannot log in or view their accounts, and it has given no date for access to return.
detail: The restriction applies to all client accounts, including child accounts managed by a guardian. The help page was last updated on Nov 27.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: Help page: "we've restricted access to client login and some services, so you can't log in or view your account right now"; "We're keeping the platform offline". EWN: it "was being kept offline".

claim_text: EasyEquities says all client funds are accounted for
summary: EasyEquities says that, based on its investigation so far, all client funds are accounted for and secure.
detail: This is the company's own account; no regulator or outside party has said so.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: Help page: "Based on our investigation to date, all client funds are accounted for and secure"; EWN attributes the same to the chief executive's afternoon update.

claim_text: EasyEquities has not said whether personal information was taken
summary: EasyEquities says it is assessing whether any personal information may have been accessed and will contact clients directly if it may have been.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: Help page: "We're assessing whether any personal information may have been accessed. If it may have been, we'll contact you directly"; TechCentral: the email did not say "whether client information had been accessed".

claim_text: EasyEquities says the incident is not related to its recent brand refresh
summary: EasyEquities says the security incident is not related to its recent brand refresh.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: Help page: "This incident is not related to our recent brand refresh"; TechCentral reports the same.

claim_text: EasyEquities says the incident is not related to the September breach at a provider
summary: EasyEquities says this incident is not related to the September 2026 incident at a third-party service provider.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: TechCentral quotes the company's Nov 26 update: the incident is not related to the one "involving a third-party service provider experienced in September 2026".

claim_text: Clients can trade through the trading desk, and some withdrawals may be delayed
summary: While logins are restricted, EasyEquities says clients can place trades through its trading desk by phone or email, and that withdrawals may take longer than usual as some are held while it completes checks.
detail: The trading desk cannot place investments on EasyProperties or EasyCrypto.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: Help page: "you can contact our trading desk directly for assistance with placing your trades" and "Withdrawals may take longer than usual. As a security precaution, some withdrawals may be delayed while we complete our checks".

claim_text: EasyEquities warns clients to watch for scam messages that claim to come from it
summary: EasyEquities tells clients to treat any unexpected call, email, SMS or WhatsApp asking for personal or banking details with caution, even if it seems to come from the company, and says it will never ask for a password, PIN or one-time code.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: Help page: "treat any unexpected call, email, SMS or WhatsApp that asks for personal or banking details with caution, even if it seems to come from us" and "EasyEquities will never ask for your password, PIN, OTP or any code".

claim_text: EasyEquities has not said whether it has told regulators
summary: EasyEquities says it is working through its legal and regulatory obligations and will share updates; it has not said whether a regulator has been told.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: Help page: "We're working through our legal and regulatory obligations, and we'll share updates here when we can".

claim_text: An identity-verification provider used by EasyEquities was breached in September 2026
summary: In September 2026 a provider EasyEquities used for identity verification, which TechCentral names as RelyComply, said an unauthorised party had got into its systems. EasyEquities said its own systems were not breached.
detail: TechCentral reports that a ransomware group calling itself Dire Wolf claimed the RelyComply breach, which affected several South African financial firms. That is the group's claim.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: September page: the provider confirmed "an unauthorised third party had gained access to its environment"; "no evidence that EasyEquities' or Purple Group's own systems were breached". TechCentral names RelyComply.

claim_text: SA Home Loans said this week that an unknown attacker got into some of its systems
summary: TechCentral reports that home-loan provider SA Home Loans told customers this week that an unknown attacker had accessed some of its systems, including one used for collections. No source links it to the EasyEquities incident.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: TechCentral: "This week, home loan provider SA Home Loans told customers that an unknown attacker had accessed some of its systems, including one used for collections".

claim_text: EasyEquities is an online investment platform owned by JSE-listed Purple Group
summary: EasyEquities is a South African online investment platform for buying shares, ETFs and other investments with any amount. It is owned by JSE-listed Purple Group, which says its brands serve more than 1.3 million people.
detail: Purple Group's results to Aug 31, 2026 give 1.316 million active clients for its Easy group.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: Purple Group: "Our brands give more than 1.3 million people access to investing" and "Active clients 1.316m"; EasyEquities: "a subsidiary of Purple Group Limited, a company listed on the JSE Limited".

claim_text: Some outlets describe it as an apparent cyberattack
summary: EWN calls it EasyEquities' "second apparent cyberattack" in three months, and TechCentral's summary calls it a cyberattack. The company's own words are "a security incident affecting some of our systems".
label: Reported
why_it_supports: EWN: "second apparent cyberattack in the space of three months"; TechCentral's summary: "EasyEquities says it's been the victim of a cyberattack", while its quotes from the company say only "security incident".
